name: repo-graph
display_name: repo-graph — structural codebase map for AI
description: Structural graph memory for AI coding assistants — navigate any codebase by structure, not guesswork.
long_description: repo-graph gives the assistant a structural map of your codebase — entities, relationships, and feature flows — so it navigates straight to the files that matter instead of grepping. It runs locally via uvx; nothing leaves your machine except a user-initiated git clone when you point it at a git URL.

tools.name: orient
tools.description: Repo overview, entry points, and where the graph is blind; full or seed-scoped structural map

tools.name: find
tools.description: Any text — symbol, keyword, stacktrace, failing test, or diff — to the ranked nodes that matter

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Blast radius: what a node affects or depends on — ranked, located, dead code flagged

tools.name: trace
tools.description: A feature end-to-end across the stack, or the shortest path between two nodes

tools.name: read
tools.description: Return a node's source, sliced from its file by line span (batch-capable)

tools.name: refresh
tools.description: Rebuild the structural graph from source (incremental; full reparse optional)
